name: Press the Nearest
desc: Walk at the nearest fighter you can see. With no one in sight, roam until the radar finds one. Fights come quickly, one after another.

name: Hunt the Weakest
desc: Walk at the weakest fighter within sight: the wounded and the ones who have won least. Falls back on the nearest in sight; with no one in sight, roam.

name: Hold the Centre
desc: Walk to the middle of the field and stand there. Whoever crosses it comes to you.

name: Keep Away
desc: Walk away from the nearest fighter you can see. With no one in sight, roam. A fight still starts when someone corners you.

name: Wait at the Edge
desc: Walk to the nearest edge of the field and stand there while the middle thins out.

name: Fall Back When Hurt
desc: While hurt, walk away from the nearest fighter you can see until health returns. With no one in sight, roam.

name: Lie Low While Crowded
desc: While the field is crowded, walk away from the nearest fighter you can see. With no one in sight, roam.

name: Loot While Crowded
desc: While more than 50 survivors are left, walk to the nearest open cache you know of: in a section you have scouted or stood in, or in sight. With none, roam. Caches lend gear for the attempt or restore health.

name: Take Cover When Hurt
desc: While hurt, walk to the nearest forest or cave and stay there: anyone inside is seen at half range. With no cover on the map, roam.

name: Wander the Field
desc: Walk to a point in another section of the field, then another. Keeps the heading until it arrives, whoever is in sight.
